summary: Phelps County lookout that the Coast and Geodetic Survey described in 1947 as a steel tower about 60 feet tall; the index marks it removed.

facts.design: four-legged steel tower with an enclosed cage on top
facts.location: about 9 miles south of Newburg, 104 feet east of the centerline of County Route T
facts.status_note: Removed. No source we found describes what remains at the site now.

notes_for_editor: Build date is in no source; the tower was already standing when the survey described it in 1947. Removal date is in no source, so there is no removed event. The 18.3 m height comes from the survey's 'approximately 60 feet' and is approximate. The record location is about 50 m from the survey point (37 47 40.87 N, 91 54 53.50 W): within tolerance, so no correction. The record already carries the page photo (uploads/1/5/9/1/1591048/5562288_orig.jpg); its subject is not verified. No staffing, fire or access information in any source read. Thin record: one short index page and the survey datasheet.
